parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment contains multiple parts. The first part, "a direct proof could be injecting some noise and compare your model with ResNet," is an explicit suggestion to perform an experiment: inject noise and compare with ResNet. This is a concrete, identifiable action — the authors know exactly what experiment to run and how to apply it (injecting noise into the model and comparing generalization against ResNet). The second part asks whether the authors have done this experiment and what the results are, which is an explicit request to report the corresponding experimental results. The third part explicitly asks the authors to explain possible reasons why their model does not outperform ResNet in Table 1, and to provide quantitative results for pattern-dependent processing depth. All of these are clearly identifiable, explicit actions: running/reporting a noise-injection comparison experiment, adding an explanation of the performance gap, and adding quantitative results for pattern-dependent processing depth. Overall, the comment contains explicit actions with concrete details on how to implement them, so authors know exactly what modifications to make.
